name: Ustyle – Complete Your Look
author: ustyleit

sections.description:
Ustyle automatically cross-sells and upsells by adding a “Complete Your Look” section to every product page. Ustyle uses AI to analyze your entire catalog, find the strongest product pairings, and generate styled outfit images with AI reasoning and match scores. Customers scroll through outfits and add everything to cart in one click. Initial generation takes a few hours depending on catalog size and you get an email when it is ready. No manual curation needed.

Key Features:

  • Cross-sell and upsell with AI-matched outfit recommendations on product pages
  • AI explains why each item pairs well, with a match score for every outfit
  • One-click “Add to Cart” lets customers buy the entire look instantly
  • Scrollable outfit carousel gives customers a smooth browsing experience
  • Styled images show how items look together, increasing purchase confidence

Works with simple products, variable products and variations. The widget follows the page language in English, Italian, German, Slovenian and Chinese.

The plugin is free, and so is your first set of looks, generated from your own catalogue after your first sync. Anything beyond that is quoted directly by us. Write to support@ustyle.it. The plugin never processes a payment and nothing is charged through WordPress.

External Services

This plugin is the WordPress side of a hosted service operated by Ustyle S.r.l. (ustyle.it). Nothing is sent anywhere until you click “Connect & Sync Products”; Disconnect on the Settings screen revokes that at any time and removes the sync webhooks. Terms of Service · Privacy Policy · Sub-processors

Ustyle backend API

api-az.ustyle.it: sends your product data (name, SKU, price, description, categories, attributes, image URLs) and store info (site name, URL, admin email, currency, versions, timezone, product count) when you connect, on every product create, update or delete after that, and whenever a plugin admin screen loads. It returns the outfit recommendations and try-on images. The same host serves the looks carousel, and only while you have the carousel switched on.

Ustyle outfit widget

ustyle-woocommerce-prod-frontend.redsky-38cc6f6c.northeurope.azurecontainerapps.io: the iframe shown on your product pages. It receives your store token, the product being viewed and the page language, on every product page view where the widget is enabled. Add-to-cart requests go to your own store, not to Ustyle.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin go to Plugins > Add Plugin, search for Ustyle, then click Install Now and Activate
  2. Go to Ustyle in the admin menu and click Connect & Sync Products. Nothing is sent to Ustyle until you connect
  3. Open Generation and click Generate my looks. Your first set of sample looks is free, and they appear on your product pages when generation finishes
  4. Want more of your catalogue styled? Write to support@ustyle.it, or book a 15-minute call

Requires WordPress 5.4+, WooCommerce 5.0+ and PHP 7.4+.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

How long until I see outfit recommendations?

Generation runs in the background and takes a few hours depending on catalog size. You get an email when it is ready.

How do I disconnect or uninstall?

Disconnect on the Settings screen stops all data being sent and removes the sync webhooks. Deleting the plugin removes every option, transient and webhook it created.

Where can I get support?

Contact us at support@ustyle.it or visit ustyle.it.
